1.w: The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH, saying:

2.w: “Thus speaks YHWH God of Israel, saying: ‘Write for yourself all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

3.w: For, behold, the days are coming, a declaration of YHWH, when I turn back the captivity of My people Israel and Judah—says YHWH—and I will return them to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.’”

4.w: And these [are] the words that YHWH spoke concerning Israel and Judah.

5.w: For thus says YHWH: “We have heard a voice of trembling, of dread and not of peace.

6.w: Ask now, and see, can a male give birth? Why have I seen every man [with] his hands on his loins like a woman in labor, and all faces have turned pale?

7.w: Alas, for great [is] that day, so that none [is] like it! And a time of distress it [is] for Jacob, and he will be saved from it.

8.w: And it will come to pass on that day, a declaration of YHWH of Hosts—[that] I will break his yoke from your neck, and your bonds I will burst, and no longer will strangers enslave him.

9.w: And they shall serve YHWH their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.

10.w: And you, do not fear, My servant O Jacob, a declaration of YHWH, and do not be dismayed, O Israel. For behold, I I am saving you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob will return and have quiet, and he will find rest, and no one will make [him] afraid.

11.w: For I [am] with you, a declaration of YHWH, to save you. Though I make a full end of all the nations to which I have scattered you there, yet of you I will not make a full end, and I will discipline you with justice, and I will not leave you unpunished.”

12.w: For thus says YHWH: “Your breach is incurable; your wound [is] grievous.

13.w: [There is] no one pleading your cause, that you may be bound up. Unto you [are] no healing medicines.

14.w: All your lovers have forgotten you; they do not seek you. For with the wound of an enemy I have struck you, the disciplining of a cruel one, over the multitude of your iniquities; your sins are numerous.

15.w: Why do you cry out concerning your breach? Your pain [is] incurable. Concerning the multitude of your iniquities, your sins are numerous; I have done these [things] to you.

16.w: Therefore all those devouring you will be devoured; and all your adversaries, all of them, will go into captivity, and those plundering you will be as plunder, and all preying upon you I will give as prey.

17.w: For I will bring up health to you, and I will heal you from your wounds, a declaration of YHWH; for they called you an outcast: This [is] Zion; no one is searching for her.”

18.w: Thus says YHWH: “Behold, I will turn back the captivity of the tents of Jacob, and [on] his dwelling places I will have compassion; and the city will be rebuilt upon its own mound, and the palace will sit according to its ordinance.

19.w: And from them shall go forth thanksgiving and the voice of those being glad; and I will multiply them and they will not be diminished, and I will glorify them and they will not be small.

20.w: And their children will be as aforetime, and their congregation will be established before Me, and I will punish upon all those oppressing them.

21.w: And their noble will be from him, and their governor will come from his midst; and I will cause him to come near, and he will draw near to Me, for who is this who has pledged his heart to draw near to Me?” A declaration of YHWH.

22.w: “And you⁺ will be unto Me a people, and I will be unto you⁺ for God.”

23.w: Behold, the tempest of YHWH! Fury has gone forth, a tempest journeying out; upon the head of the wicked it will twist [down].

24.w: The fierce anger of YHWH will not turn back, until He has done it and until He has established the purposes of His heart. In the latter days you⁺ will understand it.
